programmes.d: A Union major (Charlton Heston) chases Indians to Mexico with a condemned Confederate captain (Richard Harris) and a cavalry of prisoners.
Two old-time Wyoming fur trappers (Charlton Heston, Brian Keith) try to protect a runaway Indian (Victoria Racimo) from her angry ex-mate.
Tim Benton (Tim McCoy) escapes from prison and takes over a marshal's identity to bring the men who framed him for murder to justice.
A rancher (Tim McCoy) and his buddy (Joseph Sauers) scare rustlers out of business.
Wild Bill Hickok (Bill Elliott) puts on a badge to clean up a town.
A quiet cowboy (Buck Jones) on a white horse saves a gal (Dorothy Fay) from cattle rustlers.
A banished gunfighter (Audie Murphy) returns to his sweetheart (Merry Anders) and helps his sheriff friend (James Best) face outlaws.
A drifter crossing the Arizona desert routs a band of marauding Apaches and rescues the young survivor of a massacre.
The story of Gen. Custer (Philip Carey) and the Little Bighorn is seen through the eyes of two of his subordinates (Joseph Cotten, Darren McGavin).
An Arizona rancher (Randolph Scott) protects his empire from a rival landowner (Richard Boone) and his hired guns.
An Indian pony-express rider C1 catches post-Civil War horse thieves.
Wild Bill Hickok (Bill Elliott) and his pal (Dub Taylor) take a wagon train through Indian country.
A peaceful man (Rock Hudson) hunts down the outlaw (Phil Carey) who has abducted his bride (Donna Reed).
A Wyoming rancher's (Ernest Borgnine) wife eyes a drifter (Glenn Ford), and her ex-lover (Rod Steiger) tells her husband.
A gunfighter (Randolph Scott) loses his beloved in a robbery and hunts the man (George Macready) to blame, who is living off the loot.
A woman and her two sons plot to drive other ranchers from their land after they discover a secret water source.
